name: Google Memorystore

evidence.kv: C02: managed key-value databases and caches are the primary type; D01: Valkey and Redis versions
evidence.vector: V01: Valkey vector indexes with FLAT or HNSW, up to 32,768 dimensions

line: Managed Valkey, Redis, Redis Cluster, and Memcached data stores.

free.text: $300/90d credit; stops at expiry; 30d recovery; paid capacity bills idle

cells.regions: Iowa, South Carolina, Belgium, London, Mumbai, Singapore

sql.math: $22.48 a month per node. 1.08 GB of writable space may not fit 1 GB of data plus overhead. Client and network costs are unknown.
The $22.48 a month node charge continues while idle. Whether the 1.08 GB of writable space fits is not verified.

files.math: Memorystore does not provide file storage.

jobs.math: Streams can coordinate queues, but worker compute, logs and transfer are priced outside Memorystore.
